videos.title: pypdfium2: Best PDF Parser for Research Paper LLM Summarization
videos.promise: Extract clean multi-column text and tables from academic PDF research papers with zero hallucinated line mixes using Google PDFium C++ engine in Python.

primary_sources.title: pypdfium2 Official Documentation
primary_sources.exact_quote: pypdfium2 is an ABI-level Python 3 binding to PDFium, Google's open-source PDF rendering engine. It provides high performance and reliability, backed by automated binary generation.

primary_sources.title: Google PDFium Open Source Project
primary_sources.exact_quote: PDFium provides developers with a powerful engine for displaying and manipulating PDF files, originally developed by Foxit and open-sourced by Google in 2014.

primary_sources.title: pypdfium2 GitHub Repository
primary_sources.exact_quote: Fast, high-quality PDF page rendering and text extraction via libpdfium with zero third-party Python runtime dependencies.

misconceptions_and_corrections.misconception: All Python PDF libraries extract text in the correct human reading order across columns.
misconceptions_and_corrections.correction: Naïve text extractors read raw PDF content streams in rendering order, often interleaving left and right columns across the entire page.

misconceptions_and_corrections.misconception: pypdfium2 requires a system C++ compiler or Foxit license.
misconceptions_and_corrections.correction: pypdfium2 wheels bundle pre-compiled PDFium shared libraries with an Apache/BSD-compatible open source license.

simplifications: Complex OCR on scanned raster image PDFs is handled by external OCR pipelines; pypdfium2 parses native vector PDF text and fonts directly.
unknown_or_proprietary: Proprietary PDF font encoding quirks are resolved by Chromium's internal FreeType and HarfBuzz rendering forks.

videos.title: How ChatGPT Actually Thinks in 3D: Token to Softmax
videos.promise: See the exact 3D journey of your prompt inside ChatGPT—from sliced tokens and embedding space to attention beams, transformer glass layers, and next-word probability sampling.

primary_sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
primary_sources.authors: Vaswani et al. (Google Brain / Google Research)
primary_sources.exact_quote: The Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequence-aligned RNNs or convolution.

primary_sources.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (GPT-2)
primary_sources.exact_quote: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is used to represent arbitrary input strings as sequences of tokens, enabling effective vocabulary compression.

primary_sources.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
primary_sources.exact_quote: GPT-4 is a Transformer-style model pre-trained to predict the next token in a document using massive autoregressive language modeling.

misconceptions_and_corrections.misconception: ChatGPT searches a huge internal knowledge database or encyclopedic table to retrieve answers.
misconceptions_and_corrections.correction: ChatGPT does not store or search text files; it is a statistical neural network calculating probabilities for the next token based on learned weights.

misconceptions_and_corrections.misconception: ChatGPT plans its entire multi-paragraph response before typing the first word.
misconceptions_and_corrections.correction: ChatGPT operates strictly autoregressively, predicting one token at a time and feeding that token back into the context window for the next step.

simplifications: Multi-head self-attention mechanisms and LayerNorm operations are visualized as glowing geometric attention beams and stacked glass matrix layers for clarity.
unknown_or_proprietary: The exact parameter count, mixture-of-experts (MoE) routing architecture, and training cluster hardware for proprietary GPT-4 / GPT-4o models are kept confidential by OpenAI.

teach_back_questions.question: What is the very first step when a prompt enters ChatGPT before neural processing begins?
teach_back_questions.expected_answer: The text is sliced into numerical token IDs using a tokenizer (Byte Pair Encoding).
teach_back_questions.source_ref: Radford et al., 2019 & OpenAI Tokenizer Documentation.

teach_back_questions.question: How does self-attention enable ChatGPT to understand the context of words in a sentence?
teach_back_questions.expected_answer: Attention beams calculate mathematical weights linking related concepts across the sequence simultaneously.
teach_back_questions.source_ref: Vaswani et al., 2017 (Attention Is All You Need).

teach_back_questions.question: Does ChatGPT generate an entire paragraph at once, or predict one token at a time?
teach_back_questions.expected_answer: It predicts one token at a time autoregressively using a softmax probability distribution over its vocabulary.
